mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notification n WHERE n.recipient_user_id = #{userId} AND n.hidden_yn = 'N' AND n.read_yn = 'N' AND n.created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND (n.expires_at IS NULL OR n.expires_at >= NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE notification SET read_yn = 'Y', read_at = COALESCE(read_at, NOW()) WHERE recipient_user_id = #{userId} AND hidden_yn = 'N' AND read_yn = 'N' AND created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at >= NOW())
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification ( batch_id, recipient_user_id, sender_user_id, notification_type, title, body, target_type, target_id, read_yn, hidden_yn, created_at, expires_at ) VALUES ( #{batchId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{recipientUserId}, #{senderUserId}, #{notificationType}, #{title}, #{body}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, 'N', 'N', NOW(), DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) )

INSERT INTO notification ( batch_id, recipient_user_id, sender_user_id, notification_type, title, body, target_type, target_id, read_yn, hidden_yn, created_at, expires_at ) VALUES
( #{notification.batchId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{notification.recipientUserId}, #{notification.senderUserId}, #{notification.notificationType}, #{notification.title}, #{notification.body}, #{notification.targetType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{notification.targetId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, 'N', 'N', NOW(), DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) )
mapper.select: SELECT template_id AS templateId, template_code AS templateCode, display_name AS displayName, notification_type AS notificationType, target_type AS targetType, title_template AS titleTemplate, body_template AS bodyTemplate, active_yn AS activeYn, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM notification_template WHERE active_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY display_name, template_id

SELECT template_id AS templateId, template_code AS templateCode, display_name AS displayName, notification_type AS notificationType, target_type AS targetType, title_template AS titleTemplate, body_template AS bodyTemplate, active_yn AS activeYn FROM notification_template WHERE template_id = #{templateId} AND active_yn = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification_delivery_batch ( sender_user_id, template_id, target_scope, account_type, team_id, recipient_count, sent_count, chunk_count, status, title, body, notification_type, target_type, target_id, context_json, created_at ) VALUES ( #{senderUserId}, #{templateId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{targetScope}, #{accountType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{teamId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{recipientCount}, 0, 0, 'PENDING', #{title}, #{body}, #{notificationType}, #{targetType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{targetId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{contextJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE notification_delivery_batch SET sent_count = #{sentCount}, chunk_count = #{chunkCount}, status = 'COMPLETED', completed_at = NOW() WHERE batch_id = #{batchId}
mapper.select: SELECT b.batch_id AS batchId, b.sender_user_id AS senderUserId, sender.nickname AS senderNickname, b.template_id AS templateId, t.template_code AS templateCode, t.display_name AS templateName, b.target_scope AS targetScope, b.account_type AS accountType, b.team_id AS teamId, team.name AS teamName, b.recipient_count AS recipientCount, b.sent_count AS sentCount, b.chunk_count AS chunkCount, b.status, b.title, b.notification_type AS notificationType, b.target_type AS targetType, b.target_id AS targetId, CAST(b.context_json AS CHAR) AS contextJson, b.created_at AS createdAt, b.completed_at AS completedAt FROM notification_delivery_batch b LEFT JOIN user_account sender ON sender.user_id = b.sender_user_id LEFT JOIN notification_template t ON t.template_id = b.template_id LEFT JOIN team ON team.team_id = b.team_id ORDER BY b.created_at DESC, b.batch_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
